item.title: Winter Sports Athlete of the Season Nominees
item.description: Well the winter sports season has officially come to an end here at WCMP. We certainly had a lot of fun and memorable moments throughout the season. Thanks to Pine Insurance Agency we we able to do a Athlete of the Week to highlight some of the great local athletes in our area. But we wanted to do one more thing to recognize local athletes in our area. And that bring us our, Winter Sports Athlete of the Season Award!

item.title: DEED announces over $367,000 in funding for Broekema Beltway expansion project at Pine City facility

item.title: Winter Sports Athlete of the Season Nominees Down to 17!
item.description: We started with 35 nominees for our initial list of Winter Sports Athlete of the Season. It was not easy trying to get a list down to 35, there are so many deserving athletes in our local area. And each of those athletes is beyond deserving of this award. Sadly, we can only have two winners, one boy and one girl.So we have let a random generator pick our list of the 17 nominees who will be moving on.
